gaps: The shared session WebSearch budget (200 calls across all parallel agents) ran out after this agent's 16th search. Most planned generic and host-type queries were never run.
Not searched: 2023/2024/2026 query variants; media liability, business interruption and incident response wording queries; 'cyber policy forms library'.
Not searched: US city/county RFP or tender attachments beyond the Franklin IN, Georgia DOAS and BoardDocs hits; court filings; law-firm analyses; university appendices.
Not searched: NAIC, CISA and SBA resources beyond incidental hits. The NAIC 2024 and 2025 cyber insurance market reports appeared but were excluded because they are not wordings.

WebFetch is egress-blocked (confirmed on prowritersins.com), so the PDF links on ProWriters' sample-policy page could not be enumerated. The Coalition specimen PDF URL there is unknown; only its attachment page appeared.

Promising unexplored leads: the Sayata Labs pattern home.sayatalabs.com/cnc-wb/get_resource/carriers/SAMPLE_POLICY_FORM/<CARRIER> may host other carriers' sample forms (only COWBELL seen; other carrier names must not be guessed). UK parish and town council sites publish Coalition and other SME cyber documents. BoardDocs board packets and US public-entity pools (e.g. ACWA JPIA) post issued cyber policies.
The Washington State small agency cyber pool: only the DES APIP 2025-26 overview (a summary) was found, not the underlying wording.
